title: Broader DG + instantaneous IGR tensor/numerical search
scope: Local RTX5080 single-rank smooth full-energy Euler + instantaneous IGR; screening is single-run unless repeated explicitly. Full process wall times include startup, setup, VTK and all accepted/rejected work. No remote measurements or changed production continuum model.

source.interpretation: source_head/source_status in raw records describe live launch checkout; tested_application_source maps actual binary SHA to committed source used in its build. Later independent runner/test edits did not modify preserved executable.

build.final_repeat_context: Fresh processes, warm system/JIT caches, no compilation overlap, rotated method ordering; all timing outliers retained.

algebraic_changes: retained first-operator inverse as current-equation preconditioner
method_changes: H1 versus SIPG L2 closure discretization

data_corrections_and_limits: Original error-predictor*.json used unmatched face wave speed and are superseded for accuracy claims by error-matched-predictor*.json; both retained.
Extrapolated cadence changes face Rusanov/nodal CFL frozen-sigma characteristic speed; volume LLF already used frozen-sigma speed. Matching reference override is explicit.

Initial two-level-p3 and two-level-p2n12 harness falsely expected igr-two-level-inverse log prefix; actual igr-two-level prefix and successful current-state certificate were used to correct execution classification, with original false flag retained in run record.

Optional diagnostic scans were enabled in initial screenings and disabled consistently in final cohort; four exact p4 pairs have bitwise-equal fields. Accepted-step NaN failure timing can differ when scan disabled. Final finite-state/current-closure/q_sigma guards remain.
Stationary total_iters includes trial sweeps plus FGMRES; sweeps/accepts/fallbacks retained separately.
HDG tensor/ordinary engine timing compares different trace preconditioner packages, not isolated tensor instructions.
No speedup credit for failed horizon or failed error gate. N24 reference with scans on timed out at120s; scan-off completed70.07s.
First initial application10.606s and first cuSolver application9.686s are retained; causes outside instrumented setup not isolated. Final medians are warm-cache fresh-process evidence.
Current certificate tolerance is an algebraic acceptance check, not solution-error proof; physical comparison is independent.
Fine temporal half-dt check also disables diagnostic scans; separate scan parity supports attribution.
Dense GPU cap4096 is a bounded single-rank research route, not global scaling evidence. Three inverse validation probes are empirical checks, not a condition-number certificate.

analysis.conclusion: No native FP64 WMMA speedup versus the strong same-A FP64 control at aligned N8/N16 on this RTX 5080; ordinary FP32 also beats all compensated tensor variants in time and relative L2 kernel error.

sampling.limits: One process with fixed method order; no confidence interval or fresh-process repeats. p7/p15 are computational probes beyond admitted production p1-p4.

cost_interpretation: gpu_seconds includes every per-call packing/conversion/output operation for fused methods; zero separate phase fields mean fusion, not free packing.
FP64 WMMA and same-A ordinary FP64 use exactly the same precombined FP64 matrix and reported setup cost. No low-precision conversion or outer correction is used by either.

setup_seconds includes common physical-input construction, shared Euler flux generation and buffer setup plus variant coefficient construction/upload; it excludes the independent long-double validation.
Process initialization is separately measured (MPI, device/context, cuBLAS); warmup_wall_seconds includes three discarded calls and synchronization, including first use.
setup + warmup + 100*gpu_seconds below is a reconstructed sum of recorded costs, not measured whole-process wall time; event creation, some host harness overhead and other variants are outside it.

Scratch/shared entries are reported method storage/payloads, not total process allocation or occupancy-rounded shared-memory allocation. Common input/output arrays and CUDA/library storage are additional.
cuBLAS phase timings are independently timed and must not be added as if they were the full-operation measurement.
limits: All methods apply equivalent central-volume algebra to the same FP64 Euler-plus-prescribed-sigma flux; the reference is long-double evaluation of that operator, not a higher-precision full DG+IGR trajectory.
No closure solve, faces, temporal advancement, rejected work, or common-horizon solution quality is measured by this probe. The FP32 transport path is not thereby qualified for production.
No matrix-padding overhead at N8/N16 removes padding as the explanation for this local FP64 WMMA loss, but does not prove all WMMA layouts lose.
RTX 5080 results do not determine H100/H200/B200 performance. Native DMMA instruction execution is established separately; no unmeasured hardware FP64 peak is asserted.
